notes.title: New and Improved Demo Release!
notes.content:
Hello Steam!

I've just released my new and improved demo that will be much closer to the final version! It's available here on itch.io: [url=https://frenchcoke.itch.io/cat-clash]itch.io page[/url]. Here are the changes:

[list]
[*]More Clear effects - For some cats, their abilities were not indicated by a thrown ball. Now almost all of them should be indicated by a ball. If you played the last demo the difference should be very noticeable. This will be most obvious with the on-faint cat effects, since in the other version they happened instantly.
[*]All cats sprites - Previously, some cat sprites were still missing. Now they're not. No more default Godot icon as a filler! If you see it, I made a mistake.
[*]All items - Some items got new sprites, and I've also made the rest of the items available.
[*]Lore - I wrote a bit of lore and you can read it when you open the "New Game" tab.
[*]Fixes and rebalancing - Many fixes and rebalances which I didn't take a record of.
[/list]

That should be all of them! Once again, the full-game with multiple modes, cats, battles, and backgrounds will be releasing on Sept 6, 2024. Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Cat Clash demo now available on itch.io!
notes.content:
[h1]Something's finally ready![/h1]

A demo version of Cat Clash is now available for free on [url=https://frenchcoke.itch.io/cat-clash]itch.io page[/url]. Please give it a try and tell me what you think! I'd encourage anyone to comment their thoughts either here on Steam, itch.io, or on my Discord! Any feedback you all give would go a long way into the finished game! Thanks.
